script: Heal Bell only: print Soundproof attacker/partner block strings as selected by cMULTISTRING_CHOOSER
moveFamily.failure: Neither the opcode nor this effect script has a failed-result branch; a healthy Heal Bell still spends PP, executes the command, and prints the selected party-heal message.

semantics.healBell: Sets B_MSG_BELL. It clears attacker and present doubles partner live status1 plus STATUS2_NIGHTMARE only when that battler is not Soundproof; Soundproof sets the corresponding B_MSG_BELL_SOUNDPROOF_* bit and records the ability. Its party toHeal mask includes every non-empty, non-Egg party record whose resolved ability is not Soundproof; the controller writes zero status to every selected bit, including healthy bench records.
semantics.aromatherapy: Sets B_MSG_SOOTHING_AROMA, uses toHeal = 0x3f without an ability check, and clears attacker/present partner live status1 plus STATUS2_NIGHTMARE. Therefore Aromatherapy's controller zero-write includes Soundproof party records; Heal Bell's does not.
semantics.singles: There is no present partner in this receipt. The source-defined player mask is 0b00000111 because all three complete player records are non-Soundproof; only lead Chimecho receives an active BattlePokemon status clear in singles, while the controller synchronizes the zero status to all three records.

boundedRemainder: The OFF receipt proves healthy command execution after PP reduction, a naturally landed Toxic, and a second Heal Bell clearing the active and synchronized three-record party state. It does not directly decode text, expose the SetMonData buffer or the exact toHeal bitmask, stage a poisoned bench, or stage a Soundproof record/doubles partner; those distinctions are source-pinned and intentionally not elevated to oracle observations.
